summary: Apply the owner-provided 39-screen Gemini Pro UI/UX reference set across the tenant web application as a coherent system-wide design language, separating replaceable visual themes from explicit structural screen blueprints while preserving existing business behavior and real data flows.
protectedReason: Owner explicitly requested a system-wide UI/UX redesign and a permanent fix for the repeated theme-only redesign failure mode. The canonical UI architecture must distinguish visual themes from screen-layout blueprints. routes.tsx must require a ScreenDesign per route; ui.tsx must expose the canonical layout facade; app-shell.tsx must render the single structural boundary. No business ownership, API or data behavior is changed.
